chapters.title: Python Foundations for FastAPI
chapters.description: Master the Python basics you need to build blazing-fast APIs. We'll cover variables, data structures, control flow, functions, and type hints.

chapters.title: Your First API
chapters.description: Create your first FastAPI app, learn about path and query parameters, and understand how requests work.

chapters.title: Data Validation with Pydantic
chapters.description: Model your data, validate requests, and build robust APIs with Pydantic models.

chapters.title: Dependency Injection
chapters.description: Reuse code and manage dependencies like a pro using FastAPI's DI system.

chapters.title: Databases & SQLAlchemy
chapters.description: Connect your API to a real database, perform CRUD operations, and work with async SQLAlchemy.

chapters.title: Authentication & Authorization
chapters.description: Secure your API with JWT tokens, OAuth2, and role-based access control.

chapters.title: Testing & Error Handling
chapters.description: Write reliable tests with pytest, handle exceptions gracefully, and add logging.

chapters.title: Middleware & Background Tasks
chapters.description: Add middleware for CORS, process tasks in the background, and serve static files.

chapters.title: WebSockets & Real-Time
chapters.description: Build real-time features with WebSockets, chat rooms, and live notifications.

chapters.title: Deployment & Performance
chapters.description: Deploy your app to production, optimize performance, and scale with async.
